sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Merged Lines is a game about merging lines to win more points. The game board is composed of a grid, where you'll receive a random selection of colorful blocks, each representing a different line. Your goal is to merge these lines by aligning them horizontally or vertically, creating a new line in the process.

The game starts with a basic set of rules, where you can merge two or more lines of the same color to create a new line. As you progress, new rules are introduced, such as merging three or more lines of the same color to create a longer line, or using special blocks to clear multiple lines at once. These rules add a new layer of complexity to the game, making it more challenging and engaging.

One of the key features of Merged Lines is its ability to adapt to the player's skill level. As you clear lines, the game board will gradually fill up with new blocks, increasing the difficulty level. This ensures that the game remains challenging, yet manageable, for players of all skill levels.

The game's core mechanics are simple, yet elegant, making it easy to pick up and play.
